---
title: "Can the data be trusted?"
subtitle: "How reliable Island Transit's bus-tracking feed is, checked every day"
---

Everything built on the live feed, trip apps included, is only as good as
the feed. These are its daily grades.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
import {csv, json, pct, num, routeLabel, longDate, SERIES} from "./lib.js"
daily = csv(d3, "data/quality/daily.csv")
days = daily.map(d => ({...d, date: new Date(d.service_date)}))
latestDate = days.length ? days.at(-1).date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) : null
latest = latestDate ? json(`data/quality/days/${latestDate}.json`) : null
noData = () => html`<p>No processed days yet.</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
lq = days.at(-1) ?? null
html`${lq == null ? noData() : html`<p class="note">Latest day: ${longDate(latestDate)}.${days.length === 1 ? " Collection began at 1:24 PM Pacific that day, so it is a partial day." : ""}</p>
<div class="stat-row">
  <div class="stat"><div class="label">Did every scheduled trip show up?</div>
    <div class="value">${pct(lq.trip_coverage)}</div>
    <div class="note">of ${lq.scheduled_trips} scheduled trips appeared in the tracking at least once</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="label">Did the collector keep running?</div>
    <div class="value">${pct(lq.vehicle_uptime, 1)}</div>
    <div class="note">of 20-second checks got a good answer from the feed</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="label">How fresh are bus locations?</div>
    <div class="value">${num(lq.position_age_s_median)} seconds</div>
    <div class="note">typical age of a location when it first appears</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="label">How close are arrival predictions?</div>
    <div class="value">${lq.prediction_mae_s_5min == null ? "–" : `${num(lq.prediction_mae_s_5min / 60, 1)} min`}</div>
    <div class="note">average miss, for predictions made 5 minutes before the bus arrived</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="label">Are buses where the route says?</div>
    <div class="value">${pct(1 - lq.off_shape_share)}</div>
    <div class="note">of locations were within 100 m of the bus's published route</div></div>
</div>`}`
```

Details below follow the way survey researchers grade any data source:
[coverage]{.term tabindex="0" tip="Whether every scheduled trip shows up in the tracking at all."},
[nonresponse]{.term tabindex="0" tip="Data that should be there but is missing: failed requests, empty feeds, gaps in a bus's reports."},
[measurement error]{.term tabindex="0" tip="Data that is there but wrong: GPS wobble, buses that seem to jump, old locations, predictions that miss."},
[processing error]{.term tabindex="0" tip="Data that cannot be matched up, such as a trip in the feed that is not in the schedule."}
and [paradata]{.term tabindex="0" tip="Data about the collection itself: every request the collector made, how long it took and whether it worked."}.
Definitions: [Methods](methods.qmd).

## Over time

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
series = [
  {key: "trip_coverage", title: "Scheduled trips seen in the feed", unit: "share"},
  {key: "vehicle_uptime", title: "Collector uptime, vehicle positions", unit: "share"},
  {key: "stale_in_service_rate", title: "Stale vehicle feed while buses are scheduled", unit: "share"},
  {key: "position_age_s_median", title: "Median age of positions when first seen (s)", unit: "s"},
  {key: "longest_gap_s_median", title: "Median longest gap in a trip's positions (s)", unit: "s"},
  {key: "timepoint_coverage", title: "Timepoint events with an inferred time", unit: "share"},
  {key: "prediction_mae_s_5min", title: "Arrival prediction error 5 minutes ahead, mean absolute (s)", unit: "s"},
]
html`${days.length === 0 ? noData() : days.length < 2 ? html`<p class="empty">Charts of each measure over time appear from the second day.</p>` : html`<div class="grid">${series.map(s => html`<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6">
  <h4 style="font-size:1rem">${s.title}</h4>
  ${Plot.plot({
    style: {background: "transparent"},
    height: 200, marginLeft: 50,
    x: {type: "utc", label: null},
    y: {grid: true, label: null, tickFormat: s.unit === "share" ? (d => `${Math.round(d * 100)}%`) : undefined,
        domain: s.unit === "share" ? [0, 1] : undefined},
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
      Plot.lineY(days, {x: "date", y: s.key, stroke: SERIES, strokeWidth: 2}),
      Plot.dot(days, {x: "date", y: s.key, fill: SERIES, r: 4}),
      Plot.tip(days, Plot.pointerX({x: "date", y: s.key,
        title: d => `${d.date.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}\n${s.unit === "share" ? pct(d[s.key], 1) : num(d[s.key], 1) + " s"}`})),
    ],
  })}</div>`)}</div>`}`
```

## Details

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`${latest == null ? noData() : html`<p>Service day <strong>${latestDate}</strong>, measured against Passio schedule version
  <code>${latest.schedule.passio_version}</code>.</p>`}`
```

<details class="more"><summary>Trip coverage by route</summary>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
byRoute = latest == null ? [] : Object.entries(latest.coverage.by_route).map(([id, c]) => ({
  route: routeLabel(latest.routes, id), ...c}))
html`${byRoute.length === 0 ? noData() : Plot.plot({
    style: {background: "transparent"},
  marginLeft: 220, height: 28 * byRoute.length + 40,
  x: {domain: [0, 1], grid: true, label: "Share of scheduled trips with at least one position", tickFormat: d => `${Math.round(d * 100)}%`},
  y: {label: null},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(byRoute, {y: "route", x: "coverage", fill: SERIES, rx: 2, sort: {y: "x", reverse: true}}),
    Plot.ruleX([0]),
    Plot.tip(byRoute, Plot.pointerY({y: "route", x: "coverage",
      title: d => `${d.route}\n${d.observed} of ${d.scheduled} trips (${pct(d.coverage)})`})),
  ],
})}`
```

</details>

<details class="more"><summary>Timepoint events observed, by route</summary>

Scheduled departures at printed timepoints (arrivals at a trip's last stop)
for which a time could be inferred from vehicle positions.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
ev = latest?.events ?? null
stopRoute = ev == null ? [] : Object.entries(ev.stop_coverage.timepoints.by_route).map(([id, c]) => ({
  route: routeLabel(latest.routes, id), ...c,
  off_shape_share: ev.shape_fit.by_route[id]?.off_shape_share ?? null}))
html`${stopRoute.length === 0 ? noData() : Plot.plot({
  style: {background: "transparent"},
  marginLeft: 220, height: 28 * stopRoute.length + 40,
  x: {domain: [0, 1], grid: true, label: "Share of scheduled timepoint events observed", tickFormat: d => `${Math.round(d * 100)}%`},
  y: {label: null},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(stopRoute, {y: "route", x: "coverage", fill: SERIES, rx: 2, sort: {y: "x", reverse: true}}),
    Plot.ruleX([0]),
    Plot.tip(stopRoute, Plot.pointerY({y: "route", x: "coverage",
      title: d => `${d.route}\n${d.observed} of ${d.scheduled} events (${pct(d.coverage)})\nPositions off the route shape: ${pct(d.off_shape_share, 1)}`})),
  ],
})}`
```

</details>

<details class="more"><summary>Arrival predictions</summary>

The feed's predicted arrival time, as published a given number of minutes
before the bus arrived, minus the arrival time inferred from vehicle
positions. A positive error means the bus came earlier than predicted.
Predictions dated on another day than the trip are counted separately and
left out of the error figures.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
pred = ev == null ? [] : Object.entries(ev.prediction_error.by_horizon_min).map(([h, b]) => ({
  "Minutes ahead": +h, "Predictions": b.n, "Mean error (s)": b.bias_s, "Median error (s)": b.median_s,
  "Mean absolute error (s)": b.mae_s, "Within 60 s": b.within_60s_share, "Dated another day": b.other_day}))
html`${pred.length === 0 ? noData() : Inputs.table(pred, {format: {"Within 60 s": d => pct(d, 1)}, rows: 10})}`
```

</details>

<details class="more"><summary>Fields the feed leaves empty</summary>

Share of position reports in which each field is missing. A field missing
from every report is not sent by the feed at all.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
items = latest == null ? [] : Object.entries(latest.nonresponse.items.missing_share)
  .map(([field, share]) => ({field, share}))
html`${items.length === 0 ? noData() : Inputs.table(items, {
  columns: ["field", "share"], header: {field: "Field", share: "Missing"},
  format: {share: d => pct(d, 1)}, rows: 25})}`
```

</details>

<details class="more"><summary>Other figures for the day</summary>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
other = latest == null ? [] : [
  ["Fetch failures, vehicle positions", pct(latest.nonresponse.fetch.vehiclePositions.rate, 2)],
  ["Empty vehicle feed while buses are scheduled", pct(latest.nonresponse.vehicle_feed.empty_in_service_rate, 2)],
  ["Positions with no trip, an unknown trip, or a trip not scheduled that day", pct(latest.coverage.over_coverage.share, 2)],
  ["Impossible jumps (over 130 km/h)", latest.measurement.impossible_jumps_over_130_kmh],
  ["Vehicle timestamps in the future / going backwards", `${latest.measurement.timestamps_in_future} / ${latest.measurement.timestamps_going_backwards}`],
  ["Trip ids found in the schedule", pct(latest.processing.id_match.trip_id.match_rate, 1)],
  ["Stop ids found in the schedule", pct(latest.processing.id_match.stop_id.match_rate, 1)],
  ["Median response time, vehicle positions", `${num(latest.paradata.vehiclePositions.latency_ms_median)} ms`],
  ["Distinct vehicles reporting", latest.coverage.vehicles_seen],
  ...(ev == null ? [] : [
    ["All stop events with an inferred time", pct(ev.stop_coverage.all_stops.coverage, 1)],
    ["Positions more than 100 m off the route shape", pct(ev.shape_fit.off_shape_share, 1)],
    ["Positions moving against the route shape", pct(ev.shape_fit.wrong_direction_share, 1)],
    ["Trips that left out part of the published route shape", `${ev.shape_fit.trips_skipping_part_of_shape} (${num(ev.shape_fit.skipped_km, 1)} km)`],
    ["Route shapes that draw segments three times (corrected)", `${ev.retraced_shapes.shapes_retraced} of ${ev.retraced_shapes.shapes_used}`],
    ["Trip ids seen that are not scheduled that day", `${ev.assignment.unassignable} of ${ev.assignment.observed_trip_ids}`],
    ["Position jitter at terminals, 95th percentile", `${num(ev.jitter.jitter_m_p95, 1)} m`],
    ["Vehicles seen in the previous 30 days but not this day",
      ev.missing_vehicles.missing_count == null ? "no earlier days" : ev.missing_vehicles.missing_count],
  ]),
].map(([measure, value]) => ({measure, value}))
html`${other.length === 0 ? noData() : Inputs.table(other, {header: {measure: "Measure", value: "Value"}, rows: 30})}`
```

</details>

<details class="more"><summary>Randomness of gaps</summary>

Are the trips the feed misses spread at random, or concentrated at certain
hours, on certain routes, or when many buses are out? Shares of scheduled
trips with no position report, over all days so far. A logistic model is
fitted once there are 14 days and 30 unobserved trips.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
gaps = json("data/quality/gaps.json")
pval = p => p == null ? "–" : p < 0.0001 ? "< 0.0001" : `= ${num(p, 4)}`
gapTables = gaps == null || gaps.rates == null ? [] : [
  ["Hour band (Pacific)", gaps.rates.by_hour_band],
  ["Trips in service at the trip's start", gaps.rates.by_trips_in_service],
  ["Day type", gaps.rates.by_day_type],
  ["Route", Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(gaps.rates.by_route)
    .map(([id, v]) => [routeLabel(latest && latest.routes, id), v]))],
]
html`${gapTables.length === 0 ? noData() : html`
  <p>${gaps.days.length} day${gaps.days.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}, ${gaps.trips} scheduled trips,
    ${gaps.unobserved} with no position report.</p>
  <div class="grid">${gapTables.map(([title, t]) => html`<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6">
    <h4 style="font-size:1rem">${title}</h4>
    ${Inputs.table(Object.entries(t).map(([group, v]) => ({group, ...v})), {
      columns: ["group", "scheduled", "unobserved", "rate"],
      header: {group: "", scheduled: "Scheduled", unobserved: "Not seen", rate: "Share not seen"},
      format: {rate: d => pct(d, 1)}, rows: 20})}</div>`)}</div>`}`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`${gaps == null ? "" : gaps.model == null ? html`<p><em>Model ${gaps.model_status}.</em></p>` : html`
  <p>Logistic regression of "trip not observed" (Firth penalised likelihood), ${gaps.model.trips} trips.
  Likelihood-ratio test of all predictors together: χ² = ${num(gaps.model.lr_test_all_predictors.statistic, 1)},
  df = ${gaps.model.lr_test_all_predictors.df}, p ${pval(gaps.model.lr_test_all_predictors.p)}.
  A small p-value means gaps are not missing completely at random.
  Reference levels: ${gaps.model.reference_levels["hour band"]}, route ${routeLabel(latest && latest.routes, gaps.model.reference_levels.route)},
  ${gaps.model.reference_levels["day type"]}.${gaps.model.converged ? "" : " The fit did not converge."}</p>
  ${Inputs.table(gaps.model.terms.filter(t => t.term !== "intercept").map(t => ({...t,
      term: t.term.startsWith("route: ") ? `route: ${routeLabel(latest && latest.routes, t.term.slice(7))}` : t.term,
      ci: `${num(t.or_95ci[0], 2)} to ${num(t.or_95ci[1], 2)}`})), {
    columns: ["term", "odds_ratio", "ci", "p"],
    header: {term: "Term", odds_ratio: "Odds ratio", ci: "95% interval", p: "p"},
    format: {odds_ratio: d => num(d, 2), p: d => pval(d).replace(/^= /, "")}, rows: 30})}`}`
```

The model and its inputs: [`quality/gaps.json`](https://github.com/dfladagermccullugh-bot/Open-Island-Transit-Data/blob/data/quality/gaps.json).

</details>
